description: Mumbai's recorded manifest debt - the CITY-OWNED half of tests/check_manifest.py. Each rule's paths are the exact rows that fail it; `ceiling` is their count and may only FALL. Adding a path fails unless the ceiling is raised in the same change with a new ceiling_log entry carrying the date, the reason and `"raised": true` - an explicit, dated, reasoned raise is the only way the ceiling goes up; a listed path that no longer fails must be deleted and the ceiling lowered. A city with no file carries no debt.

raw_without_retrieved.reason: A raw file that is not a provenance record and carries no retrieval date of its own. Measured 25 September 2026 when the rule was introduced; provenance_*.json records were exempted by rule on 29 September 2026 (each carries its own dated retrieval key, which check_manifest.py now verifies), which removed them from this list.

ceiling_log.reason: measured against the committed manifest when the rule was introduced
provenance_*.json exempt by rule: a provenance record IS the retrieval record, and its own dated retrieval key is now verified instead

lineage_scope_none.reason: A row whose producing script declares no lineage at any scope, so its licence claim rests on nothing. Measured 25 September 2026 when the rule was introduced.

ceiling_log.reason: measured against the committed manifest when the rule was introduced

sha256_drift.reason: Gitignored built bytes on this workstation that differ from the committed manifest. Written 22 September 2026 18:07-18:14 (after the manifest commit 15ce0bb5 at 17:51) by a local branch deleted unmerged; they are half-applied lane tasks 4 and 5, NOT the reproducible truth, so the manifest is not regenerated over them. Settled by a one-sitting rebuild of the Mumbai chain (GitHub #252, awaiting the user's decision on tasks 4 and 5). A listed file that is absent from the checkout (CI) is not judged.

ceiling_log.reason: measured: CITYSIM_CITY=mumbai tests/check_manifest.py reports these 11 when the gate first ran it for every city (GitHub #252)

processed_without_source.reason: A derived row whose ancestry resolved to no declared source: the acquisition audits, the rows of lineage_scope none (recorded under that rule too) and the assembled run inputs. Measured 8 October 2026 when the rule was introduced (sixteenth report); the manifest is not regenerated over the drifted bytes (#252), so these leave with the one-sitting rebuild.

ceiling_log.reason: measured when the rule was introduced (sixteenth report)

produced_by_not_declaring.reason: A row attributed to the adapter that owns its directory while another script declares the file as its own output (an exact OUTPUT_INPUTS key); build_manifest.lineage_for reads the declarations since 8 October 2026 (sixteenth report), and these rows are corrected by regenerating the manifest, which waits on the rebuild (#252).

ceiling_log.reason: measured when the rule was introduced (sixteenth report)
